_schema.round: id, date (ISO), course, courseId? (slug into data/courses.json), organizer, teeTimes[], played, notes?, results[]
_schema.result: playerId, name, attended (bool), holesPlayed (9|18|null), gross (int|null), handicap (int|null), pars, birdies, eagles, albatrosses, holeInOnes. Net is derived = gross - handicap. handicap is the player's RUNNING handicap snapshotted before the round (see docs/CALCULATIONS.md).
_schema.scoring: Points per round = (attended?5:0) + pars*1 + birdies*3 + eagles*10 + albatrosses*20 + holeInOnes*25 + lowRoundPts - penalty. Pars/birdies/etc. are RAW achievements — handicap does not adjust them. Low Round: lowest NET (gross - handicap) among players with holesPlayed=18 and handicap set; ties SPLIT the 3 points evenly. All math lives in golf/lib/golf-calc.js.
_schema.terminology: Golf rounds use 'organizer'. Poker events use 'host'.
_schema.standings: Computed client-side: best 10 rounds per player count, highest total wins.

attendance.label: Attendance
attendance.description: Showing up and playing at least 9 holes of an MMP event

par.label: Par
par.description: Even strokes with the alotted strokes for the hole

birdie.label: Birdie
birdie.description: 1 stroke under the alotted strokes for the hole

eagle.label: Eagle
eagle.description: 2 strokes under the alotted strokes for the hole

albatross.label: Albatross
albatross.description: 3 strokes under the alotted strokes for the hole

lowRound.label: Low Round
lowRound.description: Lowest net score (gross − handicap) for the 18-hole session. Ties split the 3 points evenly.

penalty.label: Over handicap par
penalty.description: Score over (par + handicap), −1 pt per 5 strokes: 6–10 over → −1 pt; 11–15 → −2 pts; 16–20 → −3 pts; 21–25 → −4 pts; and so on.
